ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR54] Requires Servicing District/Market while in Negotiation, Booking Verification, Booked, Setup or Closed - should never be saved blank after Solutioning. Simplified per IRM feedback.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Framework_Parent_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity' ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'New Deal'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Renewal') ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booked'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Setup'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed') ),
ISPICKVAL(IM_Servicing_Region__c, '') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Servicing District/Market is required to advance to the next stage. Please enter a value.
